---
title: "Airline Delays Dashboard"
format: dashboard
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(lubridate)
df <- read_csv("airlines.csv") |> mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

# Shown instead of a plot when the inputs leave no rows
empty_plot <- function() {
  plotly_empty() |>
    layout(title = list(text = "No passengers match these inputs.", y = 0.5))
}
```


# Plots

## {.sidebar}

Data science salaries have grown significantly in recent years, with wide variation based on experience, location, and role. Use the inputs below to explore salary trends and filter the plots and table on the **Data** page.

```{r}
sliderInput("salary", "Salary (USD)", min = 0, max = 600000, value = c(0, 600000))
```

## Row

```{r}
#| title: Remote ratio density
plotlyOutput("p1")
```

```{r}
#| title: Experience level by company size
plotlyOutput("p2")
```

# Data

```{r}
#| title: Data used in the plots (filtered by the inputs on the Plots page)
DTOutput("tbl")
```

```{r}
#| context: server
filtered <- reactive({
  df |>
    filter(salary_in_usd >= input$salary[1], salary_in_usd <= input$salary[2])
})

output$p1 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  p <- ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = remote_ratio, color = experience_level)) +
    geom_density() +
    labs(x = "Remote Ratio (%)", color = "Experience")
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$p2 <- renderPlotly({
  if (nrow(filtered()) == 0) return(empty_plot())
  p <- ggplot(filtered(), aes(x = company_size, fill = experience_level)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill") +
    labs(y = "Proportion", x = "Company Size", fill = "Experience")
  ggplotly(p)
})

output$tbl <- renderDT({
  filtered() |>
    select(work_year, job_title, experience_level, salary_in_usd, 
           company_size, remote_ratio, company_location) |>
    datatable(options = list(pageLength = 10))
})
```
